generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Determine if the hypothesis can be overthrowed by obtained data, or methods for the experiment. Also form the contract for testing the hypothesis

contract.purpose_user_function: Label extracted claims as heuristically testable and compile a governed experiment contract with metrics, procedure, baseline, artifacts, limits, and approval requirements.
contract.valid_inputs: Claim/hypothesis text, experiment objective, variables, metrics, procedure, baseline, allowed commands, resource limits, approvals, and expected artifacts.
contract.expected_outputs: Testability classification plus ExperimentPlan contract that defines how evidence could support, refute, or leave the hypothesis inconclusive.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes/stamps experiment plan and constrains execution through command/resource/approval fields.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Non-testable or incomplete plans remain unverified/inconclusive; validation rejects missing required fields or unauthorized execution.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: The testability check is a keyword heuristic, not a rigorous logical falsifiability proof; overturning conditions are represented indirectly through metrics/outcomes.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/plugins/autosci/bin/autosci_bridge.py::_claim_testability` classifies claims and `harness/plugins/autosci/adapters/autosci_to_experiment_plan.py::convert` emits the governed plan.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test testable/non-testable heuristic, measurable outcome, refutation condition, inconclusive condition, baseline, approval, resource/command limits, and invalid contract.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/ingest`, `/ideate`, `/exp-design`, `/exp-eval`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: skills/exp-design/SKILL.md; harness/plugins/autosci/bin/autosci_bridge.py paper-claim, paper-method, and experiment-design actions
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Claim extraction and testability are deterministic heuristics; they do not establish scientific truth. Live experiment/provider routes remain approval- and configuration-gated. README.md#Platform Support states macOS is primary, Linux supported, and Windows/WSL2 experimental; live provider authentication, trust, network, quota, and approval boundaries still apply.
